item.title: "Morale Has Been Terrible" - EA Workers Criticise Publisher's Cost-Cutting After Latest Layoffs

description.p: The mass effect of mass affects.Last week, legendary RPG studio BioWare announced that it was shutting up shop as part of EA's latest round of layoffs. It was one of many studios hit by cuts from the company on the same day, which supposedly wiped out around 400 jobs.One week on, and several current and former EA employees have anonymously spoken to Vertical Slice about their time at the publisher. Unsurprisingly, they paint a rather bleak picture of what it's like behind closed doors in 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Apparently Has A Policy To Prevent Game-Key Cards Getting A Full-Cart Reprint

description.p: According to a Canadian retailer, that is.After Nintendo seemingly introduced smaller cartridge size options earlier this year, many of us wondered whether our favourite Game-Key Card releases might get a proper full-cart physical reprint down the line. Well, according to Canadian retailer Video Games Plus, that might not be possible (thanks for the heads-up, Nintendo Wire).In a now-deleted post on social media, VGP said the following: "As we’ve stated many times, we’d actively try to get existing Game-Key Card titles reprinted as full-on-cart versions, but at the moment, there’s a Nintendo policy preventing that.” Hmm.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
